Fig. 1: Overview of MalwarePT. Raw bytes are extracted from the code section of each PE file, converted into atomic byte-level symbols, tokenized with a BPE vocabulary, and split into fixed-length sequences. These sequences are used to pretrain a ModernBERT-inspired bidirectional encoder with masked language modeling, after which the pretrained encoder is fine-tuned end-to-end with taskspecific heads for downstream malware-analysis tasks.
